name: genpet
description: An image-generated native Codex Pet that begins as an egg and grows with local activity.

interface.shortDescription: A native pixel companion, growing with you.
interface.longDescription: Adopt an image-generated egg with /genpet-start and grow with local activity. Includes reset, growth and state debugging skills. Updates the same native Pet through background cache invalidation through the existing desktop IPC channel, including first initialization; reports display confirmation separately. Includes an optional local debugger, started only with /genpet-debugger.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $genpet-start 开始或恢复我的 GenPet，并启用自动成长
更新我的 GenPet 成长与形象
查看我的 GenPet 状态
